basic_info.description: Classic 1950s home in San Francisco's University Mound neighborhood, ready to be renovated. Offering 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, and 1,064 sq. ft., this residence features hardwood floors, an open living/dining layout, and a spacious kitchen. The home also includes additional bonus space with kitchenette and bathroom (both unwarranted), a two-car garage, and a spacious south-facing backyard with storage shed, plus excellent ADU and expansion potential on its 2,495 sq. ft. lot. Close to McLaren Park, Portola Recreation Center, and public transit, this is a rare opportunity in a desirable neighborhood.
